title: I made a rage baiting multiplayer jump king clone and had Claude make a trailer for it
author: cody-fifth-door

comments.author: cody-fifth-door
comments.body:
It's pretty fun to see how far you can push Claude and what you can get him to do with some simple prompts. I just gave him an eleven labs key and told him to make a trailer including gameplay with jump cuts and f-bombs. Turned out better than I though it would!  
  
The game is here: [https://play.fifthdoor.com/play/king-of-the-spire](https://play.fifthdoor.com/play/king-of-the-spire)
